items.source: Create a new CassandraRepositoryFactoryBean for the given repository interface.

items.source: Creates and initializes a CassandraRepositoryFactory instance.

items.translation: 配置 CassandraRepositoryFragmentsContributor，使其向存储库贡献内置片段功能。
